newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says to develop system with Japan.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says to develop system with Japan.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson on Thursday said it had been selected by Japan's mobile communications operator NTT DoCoMo to jointly develop the first experimental third generation wireless communications system.
Ericsson said the system would be capable of delivering high-speed multimedia services.
"The system is expected to provide a whole new range of multimedia wireless communications including full motion video, video conferencing and Internet access," Ericsson said in a statement.
"The NTT DoCoMo contract calls for the very latest in digital wireless technology and positions Ericsson as a major supplies to the wireless world of the future."
The companies said they intended to install the first experimental third generation systems by late 1997.
It was planned to have the system ready for full commercial deployment by the turn of the century to enable advanced mobile multimedia services in cellular systems.
